description: This file defines the Cobalt extension configuration API, including function pointers for various configuration options related to rendering, caching, and system behavior.

methods.name: CobaltUserOnExitStrategy
methods.description: Function pointer to determine the exit strategy for Cobalt.

methods.name: CobaltRenderDirtyRegionOnly
methods.description: Function pointer to enable rendering only modified regions.

methods.name: CobaltEglSwapInterval
methods.description: Function pointer to set the EGL swap interval.

methods.name: CobaltFallbackSplashScreenUrl
methods.description: Function pointer to get the fallback splash screen URL.

methods.name: CobaltEnableQuic
methods.description: Function pointer to enable or disable Quic support.

methods.name: CobaltSkiaCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set Skia cache size.

methods.name: CobaltOffscreenTargetCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set offscreen target cache size.

methods.name: CobaltEncodedImageCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set encoded image cache size.

methods.name: CobaltImageCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set image cache size.

methods.name: CobaltLocalTypefaceCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set local typeface cache size.

methods.name: CobaltRemoteTypefaceCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set remote typeface cache size.

methods.name: CobaltMeshCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set mesh cache size.

methods.name: CobaltSoftwareSurfaceCacheSizeInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer to set software surface cache size.

methods.name: CobaltImageCacheCapacityMultiplierWhenPlayingVideo
methods.description: Function pointer to set image cache capacity multiplier during video playback.

methods.name: CobaltSkiaGlyphAtlasWidth
methods.description: Function pointer to set glyph atlas width.

methods.name: CobaltSkiaGlyphAtlasHeight
methods.description: Function pointer to set glyph atlas height.

methods.name: CobaltJsGarbageCollectionThresholdInBytes
methods.description: Function pointer for JS garbage collection threshold.

methods.name: CobaltReduceCpuMemoryBy
methods.description: Function pointer to reduce CPU memory usage.

methods.name: CobaltReduceGpuMemoryBy
methods.description: Function pointer to reduce GPU memory usage.

methods.name: CobaltGcZeal
methods.description: Function pointer to enable zealous garbage collection.

methods.name: CobaltRasterizerType
methods.description: Function pointer to set rasterizer type.

methods.name: CobaltEnableJit
methods.description: Function pointer to enable JIT compilation.

methods.name: CobaltFallbackSplashScreenTopics
methods.description: Function pointer for splash screen topics mapping.

methods.name: CobaltCanStoreCompiledJavascript
methods.description: Function pointer to enable JavaScript caching.
